title: 2 Quakes Shook Venezuela, Colombia Weeks Apart: How Rescue Efforts Differed
summary_full: Devastating earthquakes weeks apart in Venezuela and Colombia have exposed sharply different government capacities to respond to disaster, according to witnesses in both countries, aid workers and a security firm.
